requirement_text: Click on the name of the new file to view it.
user_story: As a user, I want to click the name of a new file to view it, so that I can open it quickly.
technical_task: Make the name of each new file a link that opens the file.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new file, when the user clicks its name, then the file is displayed.
Given two new files, when the user clicks each name, then each opens its own file.

requirement_text: The product shall display room equipment according to search parameters.
user_story: As an employee, I want the product to display room equipment according to my search parameters, so that I can find rooms that have what I need.
technical_task: Show the equipment of rooms that match the search parameters.
acceptance_criteria: Given search parameters, when the user searches, then the room equipment matching them is displayed.
Given parameters that match no room equipment, when the user searches, then no equipment is displayed.

requirement_text: The notification center also displays a list of the patient and patient representee upcoming appointments the information of his or her designated HCP and the number of unread messages from his or her message inbox number of new referrals (UC33) and number of unviewed completed lab procedures (UC26).
requirement_text_raw: The notification center also displays a list of the patient and patient representee upcoming appointments   the information of his or her designated HCP   and the number of unread messages from his or her message inbox   number of new referrals (UC33)  and number of unviewed completed lab procedures (UC26).
user_story: As a patient, I want a notification center that lists my upcoming appointments, my designated HCP's information, my unread messages, my new referrals and my unviewed completed lab procedures, so that I see what needs attention.
technical_task: Extend the notification center with the upcoming appointments, the designated HCP's information, the number of unread messages, the number of new referrals (UC33) and the number of unviewed completed lab procedures (UC26).
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient or patient representee, when the notification center is opened, then upcoming appointments and the information of the designated HCP are shown.
Given the notification center, when it is opened, then the number of unread messages, the number of new referrals and the number of unviewed completed lab procedures are shown.
rationale: Role stated: patient or patient representee.

requirement_text: The solution should restrict validation of orders to authorized personnel only.
user_story: As a pharmacy manager, I want validation of orders restricted to authorized personnel, so that orders are checked by qualified people.
technical_task: Allow only authorized personnel to validate orders.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized person, when the person validates an order, then the validation is recorded.
Given a person who is not authorized, when the person tries to validate an order, then it is refused.

requirement_text: User shall post intelligence items with required spatial index and optional meta-data.
user_story: As a traveler, I want to post intelligence items with a required spatial index and optional meta-data, so that others can find them by location.
technical_task: Offer a posting form for intelligence items with a required spatial index and optional meta-data.
acceptance_criteria: Given an intelligence item with a spatial index, when the user posts it, then it is saved.
Given an intelligence item without a spatial index, when the user posts it, then it is not saved.
rationale: Role assumed: traveler. The second criterion follows from "required spatial index".

requirement_text: The system shall be able to scale to accommodate an increasing number of users and forms.
user_story: As an administrator, I want the system to scale as the number of users and forms grows, so that it keeps working.
technical_task: Design the system so capacity can grow with the number of users and forms.
acceptance_criteria: Given an increasing number of users, when the load grows, then the system accommodates them.
Given an increasing number of forms, when the amount grows, then the system accommodates them.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. No target numbers are given.

requirement_text: User shall enjoy maximal security measures implemented in the application to prevent unauthorized access.
rationale: "Maximal security measures" are not specific or measurable.
clarification_questions: What does "maximal security measures" mean in testable terms?
Which unauthorized access scenarios must be prevented?

requirement_text: Delivery boy shall be able to start the shift.
user_story: As a delivery boy, I want to start my shift, so that I can begin receiving orders.
technical_task: Provide a start shift function for delivery staff.
acceptance_criteria: Given a delivery boy who is not on shift, when the delivery boy starts the shift, then the shift is started.
Given a shift has started, when the delivery boy views the status, then it shows that the shift is active.

requirement_text: User shall experience quick and seamless authentication processes facilitated by the application.
The system shall provide three forms of logging: registration for new users, login for existing users, and restricted login for anonymous users.
user_story: As a visitor, I want three ways to log in: registration for new users, login for existing users and restricted login for anonymous users, so that I can use the system in the way that fits me.
technical_task: Provide three forms of logging in: registration for new users, login for existing users and a restricted login for anonymous users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when the user registers, then an account is created.
Given an existing user, when the user logs in, then the user gets access, and given an anonymous user, when the user uses restricted login, then the user gets restricted access.
rationale: Role assumed: visitor. What the restriction for anonymous users is not described.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to change the tempo of the music within a score.
user_story: As a musician, I want to change the tempo of the music in a score, so that I can play it faster or slower.
technical_task: Add a tempo setting to a score.
acceptance_criteria: Given a score, when the user changes the tempo, then the music plays at the new tempo.
Given a changed tempo, when the score is reopened, then the new tempo is kept.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability for a user to validate a mapping.
user_story: As a data steward, I want to validate a mapping, so that I know it is correct.
technical_task: Provide a function for a user to validate a mapping.
acceptance_criteria: Given a mapping, when the user validates it, then the result of the validation is shown.
Given a mapping with an error, when the user validates it, then the error is reported.
rationale: Role assumed: data steward. The validation rules are not specified.

requirement_text: System shall offer integration with other Google services such as Google Drive, Google Calendar, and Google Contacts for enhanced productivity.
user_story: As a user, I want integration with Google Drive, Google Calendar and Google Contacts, so that I can use my Google data here.
technical_task: Integrate the system with Google services such as Google Drive, Google Calendar and Google Contacts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Google account, when the user links Google Drive, Google Calendar or Google Contacts, then the data from that service is available.
Given the integration, when the user changes data in one service, then it is reflected where the system uses it.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Such as" means other Google services may be included; "productivity" is not measured.

requirement_text: Encrypt and decrypt electronic health information in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210(a)(1) unless the Secretary determines that the use of such algorithm would pose a significant security risk for Certified EHR Technology.
requirement_text_raw: Encrypt and decrypt electronic health information in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210(a)(1)  unless the Secretary determines that the use of such algorithm would pose a significant security risk for Certified EHR Technology.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want electronic health information encrypted and decrypted per the standard in 170.210(a)(1), unless the Secretary finds the algorithm a significant security risk, so that data is protected.
technical_task: Encrypt and decrypt electronic health information according to the standard specified in 170.210(a)(1), except where the Secretary determines the algorithm poses a significant security risk for Certified EHR Technology.
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information, when it is exchanged, then it is encrypted and decrypted in accordance with the standard specified in 170.210(a)(1).
Given the Secretary determines that the algorithm poses a significant security risk for Certified EHR Technology, when it is exchanged, then the standard is not required.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. The standard is only referenced; the section symbol in the source is garbled.

requirement_text: User shall be allowed up to three login attempts before the card is blocked.
user_story: As a card holder, I want up to three login attempts before my card is blocked, so that guessing is limited.
technical_task: Block the card after three failed login attempts.
acceptance_criteria: Given a card holder with fewer than three failed attempts, when the card holder tries to log in, then the attempt is processed.
Given three failed login attempts, when the card holder tries again, then the card is blocked.

requirement_text: System shall offer scalability to accommodate varying project sizes and complexities.
user_story: As a project lead, I want the system to scale for varying project sizes and complexities, so that it suits small and large projects.
technical_task: Build the system so it works for projects of different sizes and complexities.
acceptance_criteria: Given a small project, when the system is used, then it works.
Given a large and complex project, when the system is used, then it works.
rationale: Role assumed: project lead. Sizes are not quantified.

requirement_text: The platform shall allow translation of data type hierarchies for embedded viewers.
user_story: As a viewer user, I want data type hierarchies translated for embedded viewers, so that viewers can show them.
technical_task: Support translating data type hierarchies into a form that embedded viewers can use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a data type hierarchy, when it is translated for an embedded viewer, then the viewer can use it.
Given an embedded viewer, when the translated hierarchy is loaded, then it is displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: user of embedded viewers.

requirement_text: The trigger value is used in combination with the current temperature to determine when a heating or cooling unit shall be turned on or off.
rationale: The sentence describes how a value is used without a concrete required behaviour or value.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a definition of the trigger value?
What must the system do with the trigger value and the current temperature?

requirement_text: A sale transaction authorizes and settles the requested amount against the indicated payment method.
user_story: As a merchant, I want a sale transaction to authorize and settle the requested amount against the indicated payment method, so that I get paid.
technical_task: Authorize and settle the requested amount against the payment method named in a sale transaction.
acceptance_criteria: Given a sale transaction with a payment method and an amount, when it is processed, then the amount is authorized against the payment method.
Given an authorized sale transaction, when it completes, then the requested amount is settled against the payment method.

requirement_text: The Provider - Pharmacy Communication capability should provide non-repudiation requirements (IN 1.5) that guarantees that the sources and receivers of data cannot deny that they entered or sent or received the data.
user_story: As a pharmacist, I want the Provider - Pharmacy Communication capability to provide non-repudiation (IN 1.5), so that nobody can deny entering, sending or receiving data.
technical_task: Provide non-repudiation (IN 1.5) in the Provider - Pharmacy Communication capability for data that is entered, sent or received.
acceptance_criteria: Given data is entered or sent, when the action completes, then a record shows the source cannot deny it.
Given data is received, when the receipt completes, then a record shows the receiver cannot deny it.

requirement_text: The system shall recommend content based on user profiles, news events, and image/video similarity.
user_story: As a reader, I want content recommended from my profile, news events and image or video similarity, so that I find things I like.
technical_task: Recommend content using user profiles, news events and image/video similarity.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user profile, when recommendations are made, then they take the profile into account.
Given news events and similar images or videos, when recommendations are made, then they take news events and image/video similarity into account.

requirement_text: A content editor shall be able to easily find content to edit.
clarification_questions: How quickly or in how many steps must a content editor find content?
What search or navigation is meant?

requirement_text: An HCP chooses to document or edit an office visit.
requirement_text_raw: An HCP chooses to document  or edit  an office visit.
user_story: As an HCP, I want to document or edit an office visit, so that the visit record is complete.
technical_task: Provide a screen to document a new office visit or edit an existing one.
acceptance_criteria: Given an office visit, when the HCP documents it, then the documentation is saved.
Given an existing office visit, when the HCP edits it, then the changes are saved.

requirement_text: User shall have a cancellation deadline tied to registration/cancellation workflow, to avoid financial loss.
user_story: As a participant, I want a cancellation deadline in the registration and cancellation workflow, so that I avoid a financial loss.
technical_task: Add a cancellation deadline to the registration and cancellation workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Given a registration, when the cancellation deadline has not passed, then the user can cancel.
Given a registration, when the cancellation deadline has passed, then the user cannot cancel.
rationale: Role assumed: participant. The second criterion is an interpretation of "deadline".

requirement_text: A transmit packet queue and a receive packet queue shall be maintained for each task or Communication ID (CID).
requirement_text_raw: A transmit packet queue and a receive packet queue shall (3.3.6.7) be maintained for each task or Communication ID (CID).
user_story: As a software developer, I want a transmit packet queue and a receive packet queue for each task or Communication ID (CID), so that packets are handled per task.
technical_task: Maintain one transmit packet queue and one receive packet queue for every task or Communication ID (CID).
acceptance_criteria: Given a task or Communication ID (CID), when it is set up, then a transmit packet queue is maintained for it.
Given a task or Communication ID (CID), when it is set up, then a receive packet queue is maintained for it.

requirement_text: The patient or representative views his or her message inbox.
user_story: As a patient, I want to view my message inbox, so that I can read my messages.
technical_task: Display the message inbox to a patient or representative.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient or representative with messages, when the user opens the inbox, then the messages are shown.
Given no messages, when the user opens the inbox, then it is empty.

requirement_text: User shall be able to upload videos to their channel.
user_story: As a creator, I want to upload videos to my channel, so that viewers can watch them.
technical_task: Add a video upload to the user's channel.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video file, when the user uploads it to the channel, then the video is saved on the channel.
Given an uploaded video, when the channel is viewed, then the video is listed.

requirement_text: When access to a chart is restricted the system shall provide a means for appropriately authorized users to "break the glass" for emergency situations.
requirement_text_raw: When access to a chart is restricted  the system shall provide a means for appropriately authorized users to "break the glass" for emergency situations.
user_story: As an emergency clinician, I want to break the glass on a restricted chart in an emergency, so that I can reach the information I need.
technical_task: Provide a break-the-glass function for appropriately authorized users to open restricted charts in emergencies.
acceptance_criteria: Given a restricted chart and an emergency, when an appropriately authorized user breaks the glass, then access to the chart is granted.
Given a restricted chart, when a user who is not appropriately authorized tries to break the glass, then access is not granted.

requirement_text: The system shall display search results, filtered content, and sorted content accordingly.
user_story: As a user, I want search results, filtered content and sorted content displayed according to my choices, so that I see what I asked for.
technical_task: Display results according to the search, filter and sort selections.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search, when the user submits it, then the search results are displayed.
Given a filter or a sort order, when the user selects it, then the content is displayed filtered or sorted accordingly.

requirement_text: System shall reassure funding bodies of robust archival plans for funded research data to justify investments.
rationale: "Reassure" and "robust" are not measurable and the system behaviour is unclear.
clarification_questions: How must the system reassure funding bodies, and what are "robust archival plans"?
Is this a requirement for the system or for the project?

requirement_text: All math/science application software shall take optimal advantage of all language, compiler, and system computational features and resources to reduce run times to the minimum practical level.
clarification_questions: What counts as "optimal advantage" and the "minimum practical level" of run times?
Which math/science application software is meant?

requirement_text: This test verifies the OBC 's immunity to short circuits in the 12 V vehicle electrical system where it is feasible that a short circuit can occur in the wiring or at the OBC lines.
user_story: As a test engineer, I want a test that verifies the OBC's immunity to short circuits in the 12 V vehicle electrical system, so that the OBC survives wiring faults.
technical_task: Define a test that checks the OBC's immunity to short circuits in the wiring or at the OBC lines of the 12 V vehicle electrical system.
acceptance_criteria: Given a short circuit in the 12 V vehicle electrical system wiring, when the test is run, then the OBC's immunity to it is verified.
Given a short circuit at the OBC lines, when the test is run, then the OBC's immunity to it is verified.

requirement_text: System shall have self-monitoring to detect faults periodically.
user_story: As an administrator, I want the system to monitor itself for faults periodically, so that problems are found early.
technical_task: Add a periodic self-monitoring check that detects faults.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is running, when the self-monitoring period elapses, then a check for faults is performed.
Given a fault in the system, when the check runs, then the fault is detected.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator. The period is not stated.

requirement_text: The FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system shall utilize no more than 9 Megabytes of DRAM code and data space.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system shall [SRS258] utilize no more than 9 Megabytes of DRAM code and data space.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system to use no more than 9 Megabytes of DRAM code and data space, so that memory remains for applications.
technical_task: Limit the combined DRAM code and data space of the FTSS software and VxWorks to 9 Megabytes.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FTSS software and the VxWorks operating system, when their DRAM code and data space is measured, then it is no more than 9 Megabytes.
Given a measured use above 9 Megabytes, when it is evaluated, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: The system shall allow staff members to process appeals to track outcomes and record impacts.
user_story: As a staff member, I want to process appeals, track outcomes and record impacts, so that appeal results are documented.
technical_task: Provide appeal processing with outcome tracking and impact recording.
acceptance_criteria: Given an appeal, when staff process it, then the processing is saved.
Given a processed appeal, when staff open it, then its outcome and recorded impacts are shown.

requirement_text: User shall access the e-store in multiple languages for enhanced accessibility.
user_story: As a customer, I want to use the e-store in multiple languages, so that I can shop in my language.
technical_task: Provide the e-store in several languages.
acceptance_criteria: Given the e-store, when the user selects a language, then the e-store is displayed in it.
Given the supported languages, when the user opens the language options, then more than one language is offered.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. The languages are not listed.

requirement_text: The system shall provide the ability to capture the identity of the prescribing provider for all medication orders.
user_story: As a prescriber, I want the identity of the prescribing provider captured for all medication orders, so that orders can be attributed.
technical_task: Record the prescribing provider's identity on every medication order.
acceptance_criteria: Given a medication order, when it is created, then the identity of the prescribing provider is captured.
Given a saved medication order, when it is viewed, then the prescribing provider is shown.

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to use secure realtime messaging.
user_story: As a clinician, I want to use secure realtime messaging, so that I can exchange information safely.
technical_task: Provide realtime messaging that is secured.
acceptance_criteria: Given two users, when one sends a realtime message, then the other receives it in real time.
Given a realtime message, when it is sent, then it is protected in transit.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician. The security mechanism is not specified.

requirement_text: Record disclosures made for treatment payment and health care operations.
requirement_text_raw: Record disclosures made for treatment  payment  and health care operations.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want disclosures made for treatment, payment and health care operations recorded, so that disclosures can be reviewed.
technical_task: Record each disclosure made for treatment, payment or health care operations.
acceptance_criteria: Given a disclosure for treatment, payment or health care operations, when it is made, then it is recorded.
Given recorded disclosures, when the privacy officer opens them, then the disclosures are shown.

requirement_text: Continuous BIT shall diagnose the faulty FCR within 1 second after detecting a failure.
requirement_text_raw: Continuous BIT shall [SRS096] diagnose the faulty FCR within 1 second after detecting a failure.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Continuous BIT to diagnose the faulty FCR within 1 second after detecting a failure, so that faults are located quickly.
technical_task: Diagnose the faulty FCR within 1 second of Continuous BIT detecting a failure.
acceptance_criteria: Given Continuous BIT detects a failure, when 1 second has elapsed, then the faulty FCR has been diagnosed.
Given a diagnosis that takes longer than 1 second after detection, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: User shall deploy a dataset type independent from any app and allow apps to create and use dataset instances of that type.
user_story: As an app developer, I want to deploy a dataset type independently of any app and let apps create and use instances of it, so that datasets are reusable.
technical_task: Support deploying a dataset type on its own and allow apps to create and use dataset instances of that type.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset type deployed independently from any app, when an app creates a dataset instance of that type, then the instance is created.
Given a dataset instance of that type, when an app uses it, then the app can read and write it.
rationale: Role assumed: app developer; the requirement says user.

requirement_text: Vendor may self-certify compliance with this standard through procedures that make use of commercial malware scanning software.
user_story: As a vendor, I want to self-certify compliance with this standard using commercial malware scanning software, so that certification is practical.
technical_task: Allow vendor self-certification of compliance using procedures that rely on commercial malware scanning software.
acceptance_criteria: Given a vendor, when the vendor runs commercial malware scanning software as part of the procedures, then compliance can be self-certified.
Given a vendor that does not run the procedures, when the vendor claims compliance, then self-certification is not accepted.
rationale: Role assumed: vendor. "May" makes self-certification optional.

requirement_text: The system should avoid becoming overloaded and should maintain optimal performance even under peak load conditions.
clarification_questions: What load counts as "overloaded" and what is "optimal performance"?
What response time and capacity apply at peak?

requirement_text: The system shall leverage a Content Delivery Network (CDN) (e.g., AWS Cloudfront or Akamai CDN) to deliver videos with low latency.
user_story: As a viewer, I want videos delivered through a Content Delivery Network with low latency, so that playback starts quickly.
technical_task: Deliver videos through a Content Delivery Network, for example AWS Cloudfront or Akamai CDN.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video request, when it is served, then it is delivered through a Content Delivery Network.
Given the delivery setup, when it is reviewed, then a CDN such as AWS Cloudfront or Akamai CDN is used.
rationale: Role assumed: viewer. "Low latency" is not quantified.

requirement_text: System shall encrypt sensitive data to prevent unauthorized access.
user_story: As a user, I want sensitive data encrypted, so that unauthorized people cannot read it.
technical_task: Encrypt sensitive data.
acceptance_criteria: Given sensitive data, when it is stored, then it is encrypted.
Given encrypted sensitive data, when an unauthorized person reads it, then it cannot be understood.

requirement_text: He or she is presented with a list of the patients for which he or she is allowed to report measurements.
user_story: As a health worker, I want a list of the patients for whom I may report measurements, so that I report only for my patients.
technical_task: Show a list of the patients for which the user is allowed to report measurements.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user allowed to report measurements for certain patients, when the user opens the list, then those patients are shown.
Given a patient the user is not allowed to report for, when the user opens the list, then that patient is not shown.

requirement_text: Message passing communications primitives shall be provided for task-to-task communication as well as for broadcast to all processors.
requirement_text_raw: Message passing communications primitives shall (3.3.6.9) be provided for task-to-task communication as well as for broadcast to all processors.
user_story: As a software developer, I want message passing primitives for task-to-task communication and for broadcast to all processors, so that tasks can talk to each other.
technical_task: Provide message passing communication primitives for task-to-task messages and for broadcast to all processors.
acceptance_criteria: Given two tasks, when one sends a message with the primitive, then the other task receives it.
Given a broadcast, when a message is sent with the broadcast primitive, then all processors receive it.

requirement_text: System shall be compatible with Internet Explorer, Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome, and Safari browsers.
user_story: As a user, I want the system to work with Internet Explorer, Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome and Safari, so that I can use my usual browser.
technical_task: Support Internet Explorer, Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome and Safari.
acceptance_criteria: Given Internet Explorer or Mozilla Firefox, when the user opens the system, then it works.
Given Google Chrome or Safari, when the user opens the system, then it works.

requirement_text: System shall provide user activity reports.
user_story: As an administrator, I want user activity reports, so that I can see how the system is used.
technical_task: Generate reports on user activity.
acceptance_criteria: Given recorded user activity, when the administrator requests a report, then the user activity report is generated.
Given the report, when it is opened, then it shows user activity.

requirement_text: System shall restrict local access and maintenance of database servers to authorized IT team members only.
user_story: As an IT manager, I want local access to and maintenance of database servers limited to authorized IT team members, so that servers are protected.
technical_task: Restrict local access and maintenance of the database servers to authorized IT team members.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized IT team member, when the member accesses or maintains a database server locally, then it is allowed.
Given a person who is not an authorized IT team member, when the person tries local access, then it is denied.
